facts.text: Jolene finds music helpful during her yoga practice.

evidence.quote: I find music helps me. Any favorite tracks?
I love listening to Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds during my practice. Their music is so calming and puts me in a different headspace.

facts.text: Deborah uses candles and essential oils to enhance her yoga practice.

evidence.quote: Candles and essential oils add warmth and calm to my yoga session.
I also bought this candle for the atmosphere and to improve my yoga practice.

facts.text: Deborah enjoys instrumental tracks with mellow melodies and rhythms during her yoga practice.

evidence.quote: I find instrumental tracks with mellow melodies and rhythms help create a peaceful vibe.

facts.text: Deborah recommends an album called 'Sleep' for meditation and deep relaxation.

evidence.quote: Also, I'm listening to an album called 'Sleep,' which is great for meditation and deep relaxation.
